// Prisma schema for Nest — POS to QuickBooks sync

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// ── Enums ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

enum UserRole {
  OWNER
  ADMIN
  ACCOUNTANT
  STAFF
  VIEWER
}

enum UserStatus {
  ACTIVE
  EXPIRED
  DISABLED
  PENDING_APPROVAL
  GRACE_PERIOD
  TIME_BOMBED
  BLOCKED
}

enum AdminRequestStatus {
  PENDING
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

// ── Core Models ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

model User {
  id                  String      @id @default(cuid())
  email               String      @unique
  name                String?
  password            String?
  emailVerified       Boolean     @default(false)
  role                UserRole    @default(VIEWER)
  status              UserStatus  @default(ACTIVE)
  adminId             String?
  /// @deprecated Migrated to permissions JSON
  canScan             Boolean     @default(false)
  /// @deprecated Migrated to permissions JSON
  canMap              Boolean     @default(false)
  /// @deprecated Migrated to permissions JSON
  canSync             Boolean     @default(false)
  /// @deprecated Migrated to permissions JSON
  canManageLocs       Boolean     @default(false)
  mustChangePassword  Boolean     @default(false)
  trialExpiresAt      DateTime?
  subscriptionSource  String?
  stripeCustomerId    String?     @unique
  stripeSubscriptionId String?
  currentPlan         String?
  planInterval        String?
  currentPeriodEnd    DateTime?
  cancelAtPeriodEnd   Boolean     @default(false)
  paymentIssue        Boolean     @default(false)
  customExpiryMessage String?
  maxUsers            Int?
  maxLocations        Int?
  createdAt           DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime    @updatedAt

  permissions         Json?
  timeBombAt          DateTime?
  gracePeriodHours    Int         @default(48)
  blocked             Boolean     @default(false)
  blockedById         String?
  approvedById        String?
  approvedAt          DateTime?
  invitedById         String?
  transferredFromId   String?

  admin               User?          @relation("AdminUsers", fields: [adminId], references: [id])
  teamMembers         User[]         @relation("AdminUsers")
  locations           Location[]     @relation("UserLocations")
  managedLocations    Location[]     @relation("AdminLocations")
  qbTokens            QBToken[]
  oauthStates         OAuthState[]
  products            Product[]
  approvedRequests     AdminRequest[]       @relation("ApprovedAdminRequests")
  auditLogs            AuditLog[]           @relation("AuditActor")
  auditTargets         AuditLog[]           @relation("AuditTarget")
  passwordResetTokens   PasswordResetToken[]
  emailVerificationTokens  EmailVerificationToken[]
  blockedBy             User?          @relation("BlockedBy", fields: [blockedById], references: [id])
  blockedUsers          User[]         @relation("BlockedBy")
  approvedBy            User?          @relation("ApprovedBy", fields: [approvedById], references: [id])
  approvedUsers         User[]         @relation("ApprovedBy")
  invitedBy             User?          @relation("InvitedBy", fields: [invitedById], references: [id])
  invitedUsers          User[]         @relation("InvitedBy")
  transferredFrom       User?          @relation("TransferredFrom", fields: [transferredFromId], references: [id])
  transferredTo         User[]         @relation("TransferredFrom")
  inviteLinks           InviteLink[]   @relation("InviteCreator")

  @@index([blockedById])
  @@index([approvedById])
  @@index([invitedById])
  @@index([transferredFromId])
  @@index([adminId])
  @@map("users")
}

model AdminRequest {
  id            String             @id @default(cuid())
  email         String
  name          String?
  requestedBy   String?
  approvedById  String?
  status        AdminRequestStatus @default(PENDING)
  description   String?
  company        String?
  createdAt     DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime           @updatedAt

  approvedBy    User?              @relation("ApprovedAdminRequests", fields: [approvedById], references: [id])

  @@index([email])
  @@map("admin_requests")
}

model AuditLog {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  actorId      String
  action       String
  targetUserId String?
  details      Json?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  actor      User     @relation("AuditActor", fields: [actorId], references: [id])
  targetUser User?    @relation("AuditTarget", fields: [targetUserId], references: [id])

  @@index([actorId])
  @@index([action])
  @@index([targetUserId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("audit_logs")
}

model InviteLink {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  token     String    @unique
  createdBy String
  roleHint  UserRole?
  expiresAt DateTime
  usedAt    DateTime?
  maxUses   Int       @default(1)
  useCount  Int       @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  creator   User      @relation("InviteCreator", fields: [createdBy], references: [id])

  @@index([createdBy])
  @@index([expiresAt])
  @@map("invite_links")
}

// Kept for backward compatibility — old access-request flow data may still exist
// AccessRequest model removed — use AdminRequest instead

model Location {
  id          String       @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  adminId     String?
  name        String
  posUrl      String       @default("")
  isActive    Boolean      @default(true)
  memoTemplate      String?
  docNumberTemplate String?
  createdAt   DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime     @updatedAt

  user        User         @relation("UserLocations", fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  admin       User?        @relation("AdminLocations", fields: [adminId], references: [id])
  mappings    Mapping[]
  rules       Rule[]
  scanRecords ScanRecord[]
  templates   Template[]

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([adminId])
  @@map("locations")
}

model Template {
  id                String          @id @default(cuid())
  locationId        String
  name              String
  transactionType   String          @default("JOURNAL_ENTRY")
  lineType          String          @default("journal_entry")
  version           Int             @default(1)
  defaults          Json?
  columnMappings    Json?
  memoTemplate      String?
  docNumberTemplate String?
  isActive          Boolean         @default(true)
  createdAt         DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime        @updatedAt

  location          Location        @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  mappings          Mapping[]
  rules             Rule[]
  productMappings   ProductMapping[]

  @@index([locationId])
  @@map("templates")
}

model Mapping {
  id                String   @id @default(cuid())
  locationId        String
  templateId        String?
  sourceField       String   // e.g. "Food Sales", "Credit Card Tips"
  targetAccount     String   // QB Account name or ID
  postingType       String   @default("Credit")
  keepSeparate      Boolean  @default(false)
  targetClass       String?  // QB Class (optional)
  targetName        String?  // QB Name/Entity (optional)
  targetDescription String?
  targetMemo        String?
  priority          Int      @default(0)
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt
  location          Location @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  template          Template? @relation(fields: [templateId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([locationId])
  @@index([templateId])
  @@map("mappings")
}

model ProductMapping {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  templateId  String
  productId   String
  accountId   String
  postingType String   @default("Credit")
  classId     String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  template    Template @relation(fields: [templateId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product     Product  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([templateId, productId])
  @@index([templateId])
  @@index([productId])
  @@map("product_mappings")
}

model Rule {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  locationId String
  templateId String?
  name       String
  ruleType   RuleType
  config     Json     // stores source fields, operator, target, etc.
  isActive   Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt
  location   Location @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  template   Template? @relation(fields: [templateId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([locationId])
  @@index([templateId])
  @@map("rules")
}

enum RuleType {
  COMBINE
  DEDUCT
  THRESHOLD
  FORMULA
}

model ScanRecord {
  id            String       @id @default(cuid())
  locationId    String
  scanDate      DateTime
  rawData       Json         // all extracted Toast fields
  rawScanEntry  Json?        // full ScanEntry for Excel/image/pdf sources
  source        String       @default("pos")   // pos | excel | image | pdf
  status        ScanStatus   @default(PENDING)
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime     @updatedAt
  location      Location     @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  syncLogs      SyncLog[]

  @@index([locationId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([source])
  @@map("scan_records")
}

enum ScanStatus {
  PENDING
  MAPPED
  SYNCED
  FAILED
}

model SyncLog {
  id               String     @id @default(cuid())
  scanRecordId     String
  qbJournalEntryId String?
  docNumber        String?    // for traceability back to QB JE
  status           SyncStatus
  errorMessage     String?
  errorType        String?    // 'TRANSIENT' | 'AUTH' | 'VALIDATION' | 'FATAL'
  attemptCount     Int        @default(1)
  requestPayload   Json?
  syncedAt         DateTime   @default(now())
  scanRecord       ScanRecord @relation(fields: [scanRecordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([scanRecordId])
  @@map("sync_logs")
}

enum SyncStatus {
  SUCCESS
  FAILED
}

// QB OAuth token storage (one row per user/realm)
model QBToken {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId        String   @unique
  realmId       String
  accessToken   String
  refreshToken  String
  expiresAt     DateTime
  stale         Boolean  @default(false)  // true when refresh token is expired
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt
  user          User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("qb_tokens")
}

// Persisted OAuth state — survives server restarts (one-time use, TTL enforced in code)
model OAuthState {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  state     String   @unique
  userId    String
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([state])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("oauth_states")
}

model PasswordResetToken {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  token     String    @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  usedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  @@index([token])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("password_reset_tokens")
}

model EmailVerificationToken {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  token     String   @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([token])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("email_verification_tokens")
}

model Product {
  id              String           @id @default(cuid())
  name            String
  userId          String
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime         @updatedAt

  user            User             @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  productMappings ProductMapping[]

  @@unique([userId, name])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("products")
}

// Prisma schema for Nest — POS to QuickBooks sync

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// ── Enums ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

enum UserRole {
  OWNER
  ADMIN
  ACCOUNTANT
  STAFF
  VIEWER
}

enum UserStatus {
  ACTIVE
  EXPIRED
  DISABLED
  PENDING_APPROVAL
  GRACE_PERIOD
  TIME_BOMBED
  BLOCKED
}

enum AdminRequestStatus {
  PENDING
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

// ── Core Models ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

model User {
  id                  String      @id @default(cuid())
  email               String      @unique
  name                String?
  password            String?
  emailVerified       Boolean     @default(false)
  role                UserRole    @default(VIEWER)
  status              UserStatus  @default(ACTIVE)
  adminId             String?
  /// @deprecated Migrated to permissions JSON
  canScan             Boolean     @default(false)
  /// @deprecated Migrated to permissions JSON
  canMap              Boolean     @default(false)
  /// @deprecated Migrated to permissions JSON
  canSync             Boolean     @default(false)
  /// @deprecated Migrated to permissions JSON
  canManageLocs       Boolean     @default(false)
  mustChangePassword  Boolean     @default(false)
  trialExpiresAt      DateTime?
  subscriptionSource  String?
  stripeCustomerId    String?     @unique
  stripeSubscriptionId String?
  currentPlan         String?
  planInterval        String?
  currentPeriodEnd    DateTime?
  cancelAtPeriodEnd   Boolean     @default(false)
  paymentIssue        Boolean     @default(false)
  customExpiryMessage String?
  maxUsers            Int?
  maxLocations        Int?
  createdAt           DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime    @updatedAt

  permissions         Json?
  timeBombAt          DateTime?
  gracePeriodHours    Int         @default(48)
  blocked             Boolean     @default(false)
  blockedById         String?
  approvedById        String?
  approvedAt          DateTime?
  invitedById         String?
  transferredFromId   String?

  admin               User?          @relation("AdminUsers", fields: [adminId], references: [id])
  teamMembers         User[]         @relation("AdminUsers")
  locations           Location[]     @relation("UserLocations")
  managedLocations    Location[]     @relation("AdminLocations")
  qbTokens            QBToken[]
  oauthStates         OAuthState[]
  products            Product[]
  approvedRequests     AdminRequest[]       @relation("ApprovedAdminRequests")
  auditLogs            AuditLog[]           @relation("AuditActor")
  auditTargets         AuditLog[]           @relation("AuditTarget")
  passwordResetTokens   PasswordResetToken[]
  emailVerificationTokens  EmailVerificationToken[]
  blockedBy             User?          @relation("BlockedBy", fields: [blockedById], references: [id])
  blockedUsers          User[]         @relation("BlockedBy")
  approvedBy            User?          @relation("ApprovedBy", fields: [approvedById], references: [id])
  approvedUsers         User[]         @relation("ApprovedBy")
  invitedBy             User?          @relation("InvitedBy", fields: [invitedById], references: [id])
  invitedUsers          User[]         @relation("InvitedBy")
  transferredFrom       User?          @relation("TransferredFrom", fields: [transferredFromId], references: [id])
  transferredTo         User[]         @relation("TransferredFrom")
  inviteLinks           InviteLink[]   @relation("InviteCreator")

  @@index([blockedById])
  @@index([approvedById])
  @@index([invitedById])
  @@index([transferredFromId])
  @@index([adminId])
  @@map("users")
}

model AdminRequest {
  id            String             @id @default(cuid())
  email         String
  name          String?
  requestedBy   String?
  approvedById  String?
  status        AdminRequestStatus @default(PENDING)
  description   String?
  company        String?
  createdAt     DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime           @updatedAt

  approvedBy    User?              @relation("ApprovedAdminRequests", fields: [approvedById], references: [id])

  @@index([email])
  @@map("admin_requests")
}

model AuditLog {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  actorId      String
  action       String
  targetUserId String?
  details      Json?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  actor      User     @relation("AuditActor", fields: [actorId], references: [id])
  targetUser User?    @relation("AuditTarget", fields: [targetUserId], references: [id])

  @@index([actorId])
  @@index([action])
  @@index([targetUserId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("audit_logs")
}

model InviteLink {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  token     String    @unique
  createdBy String
  roleHint  UserRole?
  expiresAt DateTime
  usedAt    DateTime?
  maxUses   Int       @default(1)
  useCount  Int       @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  creator   User      @relation("InviteCreator", fields: [createdBy], references: [id])

  @@index([createdBy])
  @@index([expiresAt])
  @@map("invite_links")
}

// Kept for backward compatibility — old access-request flow data may still exist
// AccessRequest model removed — use AdminRequest instead

model Location {
  id          String       @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  adminId     String?
  name        String
  posUrl      String       @default("")
  isActive    Boolean      @default(true)
  memoTemplate      String?
  docNumberTemplate String?
  createdAt   DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime     @updatedAt

  user        User         @relation("UserLocations", fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  admin       User?        @relation("AdminLocations", fields: [adminId], references: [id])
  mappings    Mapping[]
  rules       Rule[]
  scanRecords ScanRecord[]
  templates   Template[]

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([adminId])
  @@map("locations")
}

model Template {
  id                String          @id @default(cuid())
  locationId        String
  name              String
  transactionType   String          @default("JOURNAL_ENTRY")
  lineType          String          @default("journal_entry")
  version           Int             @default(1)
  defaults          Json?
  columnMappings    Json?
  memoTemplate      String?
  docNumberTemplate String?
  isActive          Boolean         @default(true)
  createdAt         DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime        @updatedAt

  location          Location        @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  mappings          Mapping[]
  rules             Rule[]
  productMappings   ProductMapping[]

  @@index([locationId])
  @@map("templates")
}

model Mapping {
  id                String   @id @default(cuid())
  locationId        String
  templateId        String?
  sourceField       String   // e.g. "Food Sales", "Credit Card Tips"
  targetAccount     String   // QB Account name or ID
  postingType       String   @default("Credit")
  keepSeparate      Boolean  @default(false)
  targetClass       String?  // QB Class (optional)
  targetName        String?  // QB Name/Entity (optional)
  targetDescription String?
  targetMemo        String?
  priority          Int      @default(0)
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt
  location          Location @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  template          Template? @relation(fields: [templateId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([locationId])
  @@index([templateId])
  @@map("mappings")
}

model ProductMapping {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  templateId  String
  productId   String
  accountId   String
  postingType String   @default("Credit")
  classId     String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  template    Template @relation(fields: [templateId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product     Product  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([templateId, productId])
  @@index([templateId])
  @@index([productId])
  @@map("product_mappings")
}

model Rule {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  locationId String
  templateId String?
  name       String
  ruleType   RuleType
  config     Json     // stores source fields, operator, target, etc.
  isActive   Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt
  location   Location @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  template   Template? @relation(fields: [templateId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([locationId])
  @@index([templateId])
  @@map("rules")
}

enum RuleType {
  COMBINE
  DEDUCT
  THRESHOLD
  FORMULA
}

model ScanRecord {
  id            String       @id @default(cuid())
  locationId    String
  scanDate      DateTime
  rawData       Json         // all extracted Toast fields
  rawScanEntry  Json?        // full ScanEntry for Excel/image/pdf sources
  source        String       @default("pos")   // pos | excel | image | pdf
  status        ScanStatus   @default(PENDING)
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime     @updatedAt
  location      Location     @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  syncLogs      SyncLog[]

  @@index([locationId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([source])
  @@map("scan_records")
}

enum ScanStatus {
  PENDING
  MAPPED
  SYNCED
  FAILED
}

model SyncLog {
  id               String     @id @default(cuid())
  scanRecordId     String
  qbJournalEntryId String?
  docNumber        String?    // for traceability back to QB JE
  status           SyncStatus
  errorMessage     String?
  errorType        String?    // 'TRANSIENT' | 'AUTH' | 'VALIDATION' | 'FATAL'
  attemptCount     Int        @default(1)
  requestPayload   Json?
  syncedAt         DateTime   @default(now())
  scanRecord       ScanRecord @relation(fields: [scanRecordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([scanRecordId])
  @@map("sync_logs")
}

enum SyncStatus {
  SUCCESS
  FAILED
}

// QB OAuth token storage (one row per user/realm)
model QBToken {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId        String   @unique
  realmId       String
  accessToken   String
  refreshToken  String
  expiresAt     DateTime
  stale         Boolean  @default(false)  // true when refresh token is expired
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt
  user          User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("qb_tokens")
}

// Persisted OAuth state — survives server restarts (one-time use, TTL enforced in code)
model OAuthState {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  state     String   @unique
  userId    String
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([state])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("oauth_states")
}

model PasswordResetToken {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  token     String    @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  usedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  @@index([token])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("password_reset_tokens")
}

model EmailVerificationToken {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  token     String   @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([token])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("email_verification_tokens")
}

model Product {
  id              String           @id @default(cuid())
  name            String
  userId          String
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime         @updatedAt

  user            User             @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  productMappings ProductMapping[]

  @@unique([userId, name])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("products")
}
